import sympy as sp
al=sp.sin(sp.rad(31))
v=sp.N(sp.cot(sp.rad(59)),30)
opts={'A':al/sp.sqrt(1-al**2),'B':al/sp.sqrt(1+al**2),'C':sp.sqrt(1+al**2)/al,'D':sp.sqrt(1-al**2)/(2*al)}
assert abs(v-sp.N(opts['A'],30))<1e-20
for k in 'BCD': assert abs(v-sp.N(opts[k],30))>1e-6

import sympy as sp
th=sp.symbols('th')
sol=[s for s in sp.solve(sp.Eq(1/(1-sp.sin(th))+1/(1+sp.sin(th)),4/sp.cos(th)),th) if 0<float(s)<float(sp.pi/2)]
assert len(sol)==1
v=sp.simplify(sp.cot(sol[0])+sp.csc(sol[0]))
opts={'A':sp.sqrt(6),'B':sp.sqrt(5),'C':sp.sqrt(2),'D':sp.sqrt(3)}
assert sp.simplify(v-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert sp.simplify(v-opts[k])!=0

import sympy as sp
p=sp.symbols('p')
pv=sp.solve(sp.Eq(p*(sp.sqrt(3)+sp.cot(sp.pi/6)),sp.tan(sp.pi/3)**3-2*sp.sin(sp.pi/3)),p)[0]
opts={'A':sp.sqrt(3),'B':1,'C':-1,'D':2*sp.sqrt(3)}
assert sp.simplify(pv-opts['B'])==0
for k in 'ACD': assert sp.simplify(pv-opts[k])!=0
